[m5:codex-fanout] Probe task — verify the full loop works. In your worktree (agents/codex-1, branch agents/codex-1):
1. Create a file NOTES.md at repo root with one line: "codex-1 online — probe ok".
2. git add + commit ("probe: verify codex-1 loop").
3. git push -u origin agents/codex-1.
4. Open a PR: gh pr create --base alpha --head agents/codex-1 --title "probe: codex-1 online" --body "verifying dispatch/report loop".
Done-criteria: PR opened successfully.
Report back here with: maw hey codex-fanout:lead "done — PR #<N>" (or "blocked — <reason>" if anything fails). This is how you talk back to me.

[m5:codex-fanout] Nudge — stop searching the fleet, here is the direct answer:
Your window/pane target is "codex-fanout:1" (not "codex-fanout:lead" — I only used role names in prompts, but real dispatch targets are <session>:<window-index-or-name>). Send your report now:
maw hey codex-fanout:1 "done — PR #1"
General rule for next time: to find your own valid targets, run `maw ls -v` or `tmux list-windows -t codex-fanout` and use the session:index or session:window-name shown there — role names from the charter prompt are NOT guaranteed to equal the tmux window name.
